 Alexander Zverev’s tenure as the No. 1 in men’s tennis has started with a 7-6, 6-2 defeat to Lorenzo Musetti in the second round of the Paris Masters. The two-time Grand Slam champion Zverev moved to the top ranking on Monday. On a fast indoor court Musetti had more winners and less unforced errors than Zverev. In later matches Novak Djokovic faces qualifier Rinky Hijikata and Carlos Alcaraz plays American Alex Michelsen.

 PARIS (AP) — Alexander Zverev's tenure as the No. 1 in men's tennis started with a 7-6 (5), 6-2 defeat to Lorenzo Musetti in the second round of the Paris Masters on Wednesday.
 Zverev moved to the top ranking on Monday, capping off a fine season which saw him win the first two Grand Slam titles of his career at the French Open and the U.S. Open .
